concept: Christmas opening hours as a door calendar, rendered in 3D (Blender). One made-up pine-green card calendar with a door for each day from 24 to 31 December, the 25th in cream with a red numeral, lying on a crimson table and shot from the same side four ways. The door marked 25 lifts: Closed. Lower and nearer, the 24 lifts beside it: Open to 1pm. From above, the 25th filling the frame: does Google know? Then three open doors in a row, all readable: set special hours. Crimson, pine green, cream card and one red.
